morning-king.text: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, wal-hamdu lillaah. Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.

audit-milk.text: Allaahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa at'imnaa khayran minh. Wa idhaa suqiya labanan falyaqul: Allaahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa zidnaa minh.

audit-host.text: Allaahumma baarik lahum fee maa razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.

audit-graves.text: As-salaamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyaari minal-mu'mineena wal-Muslimeen, wa innaa in shaa'allaahu lalaahiqoon. As'alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah.

audit-tashahhud.text: At-tahiyyaatu lillaahi was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaat. As-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh. As-salaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen. Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh.

audit-istikhara.text: Allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'adheem. Fa innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa laa a'lam, wa anta 'allaamul-ghuyoob. Allaahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna haadhal-amra khayrun lee fee deenee wa ma'aashee wa 'aaqibati amree, faqdurhu lee wa yassirhu lee, thumma baarik lee feeh. Wa in kunta ta'lamu anna haadhal-amra sharrun lee fee deenee wa ma'aashee wa 'aaqibati amree, fasrifhu 'annee wasrifnee 'anh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kaana, thumma ardinee bih.

verses.text: Qul huwallaahu ahad.
Allaahus-samad.
Lam yalid wa lam yoolad.
Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.

audit-garment-praise.text: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhath-thawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.

audit-after-wudu.text: Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasooluh.

audit-meeting.text: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdik. Ashhadu an laa ilaaha illaa ant. Astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.

audit-night-wake.text: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer. Al-hamdu lillaah, wa subhaanallaah, wa laa ilaaha illallaah, wallaahu akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah. Allaahummaghfir lee.

quranVerses.2:201: Wa minhum man yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
quranVerses.2:255: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom. Laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm. Lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi idhnih. Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ard, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
quranVerses.2:285: Aamanar-rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minoon. Kullun aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih. Laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulih. Wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa, ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa ilaykal-maseer.
quranVerses.2:286: Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa. Lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alayhaa maktasabat. Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa. Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa. Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih. Wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa, warhamnaa. Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
quranVerses.3:8: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wa hab lanaa min ladunka rahmah. Innaka antal-Wahhaab.
quranVerses.3:9: Rabbanaa innaka jaami'un-naasi liyawmin laa rayba feeh. Innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad.
quranVerses.3:16: Alladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
quranVerses.3:53: Rabbanaa aamannaa bimaa anzalta wattaba'nar-rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen.
quranVerses.3:147: Wa maa kaana qawlahum illaa an qaaloo rabbanaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
quranVerses.3:193: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyan yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo birabbikum fa aamannaa. Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi'aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar.
quranVerses.3:194: Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'adtanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamah. Innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad.
quranVerses.7:23: Qaalaa rabbanaa dhalamnaa anfusanaa wa in lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen.
quranVerses.7:126: Wa maa tanqimu minnaa illaa an aamannaa bi aayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa. Rabbanaa afrigh 'alaynaa sabran wa tawaffanaa Muslimeen.
quranVerses.14:40: Rabbij'alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee. Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aa'.
quranVerses.14:41: Rabbanaghfir lee wa liwaalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab.
quranVerses.17:24: Wakhfid lahumaa janaahadh-dhulli minar-rahmati wa qul rabbirhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa.
quranVerses.18:10: Idh awal-fityatu ilal-kahfi faqaaloo rabbanaa aatinaa min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa.
quranVerses.20:114: Fata'aalallaahul-Malikul-Haqq. Wa laa ta'jal bil-Qur'aani min qabli an yuqdaa ilayka wahyuhu wa qul rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa.
quranVerses.21:83: Wa Ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahu annee massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen.
quranVerses.21:87: Wa dhan-Nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fadhanna an lan naqdira 'alayhi fanaadaa fidh-dhulumaati an laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen.
quranVerses.23:97: Wa qul rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen.
quranVerses.23:109: Innahu kaana fareequn min 'ibaadee yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa anta khayrur-raahimeen.
quranVerses.23:118: Wa qul rabbighfir warham wa anta khayrur-raahimeen.
quranVerses.25:65: Walladheena yaqooloona rabbanasrif 'annaa 'adhaaba Jahannam. Inna 'adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa.
quranVerses.25:74: Walladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa.
quranVerses.27:19: Fatabassama daahikan min qawlihaa wa qaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen.
quranVerses.28:16: Qaala rabbi innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lah. Innahu huwal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.
quranVerses.28:24: Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawallaa iladh-dhilli faqaala rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer.
quranVerses.46:15: Wa wassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi ihsaanaa. Hamalat-hu ummuhu kurhan wa wada'at-hu kurhaa. Wa hamluhu wa fisaaluhu thalaathoona shahraa. Hattaa idhaa balagha ashuddahu wa balagha arba'eena sanatan qaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee. Innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal-Muslimeen.
quranVerses.59:10: Walladheena jaa'oo min ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillan lilladheena aamanoo. Rabbanaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem.
quranVerses.66:8: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo tooboo ilallaahi tawbatan nasoohan 'asaa rabbukum an yukaffira 'ankum sayyi'aatikum wa yudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar. Yawma laa yukhzillaahun-nabiyya walladheena aamanoo ma'ah. Nooruhum yas'aa bayna aydeehim wa bi aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa. Innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer.
quranVerses.66:11: Wa daraballaahu mathalan lilladheena aamanumra'ata Fir'awn. Idh qaalat rabbibni lee 'indaka baytan fil-jannati wa najjinee min Fir'awna wa 'amalihi wa najjinee minal-qawmidh-dhaalimeen.
